skill_name: Suggest ways to make this story more interesting.
workflow: She notices a man and a woman walking on the path ahead of her, and realizes it’s an old college classmate she hasn’t seen in years. She quickly catches up to them and starts walking alongside, catching up with them and finding out what they’ve been up to over the years. As they’re talking, they notice the same noise coming from behind them—it’s the same rustling of leaves. This time, they notice a mysterious figure walking in the shadows behind them. It turns out the figure is an old professor
